payload.text: I used to believe that fully remote work was non-negotiable, as I prized uninterrupted focus and the freedom to arrange my day without office oversight. I now prefer a hybrid model—three days in person per week—balancing solitude for deep work with human interaction to maintain energy and judgment. My shift was driven by recognizing that isolation, while initially appealing, has a real cost to my mental and emotional well-being.
